description: Place an outbound call through a KaiCalls AI agent: call back a customer who previously called this business, give the owner a voice preview, or call on the owner's behalf (a landlord, clinic, pharmacy, school or utility) with the task in context. For a customer callback, pass the existing lead_id and callback goal in context. Kai verifies the business's inbound-call consent for the exact destination; a verified callback can go directly to a cell phone without connecting the owner. Contact existence alone is not callback permission, and opt-outs still block calls. A call never proves inbound routing or advances activation. report_language sets the language the result is reported in, and Kai then confirms exact details for that reader; Kai speaks call_language (English by default) on the phone. A new account's first call to a US or Canada business line is free; after that the account needs a plan. Kai calls businesses, not personal cell phones, on a free call. For a business that answers on a cell phone, connect_me has Kai ring the person's own saved phone and connect them, so they do the talking. While the call runs, check_call_status shows its live_transcript and send_call_note steers Kai. hold_for_me has Kai wait on hold at a business and connect the person when someone answers. An idempotency_key makes the request safely retryable. Only `to` is required: with no agent_id the account's one agent places the call.

agent_id.description: KaiCalls agent ID to use for the call (optional). Leave it out when the account has one agent: Kai uses that one. With several agents and none named, no call is placed and the answer lists them

call_language.description: Language Kai speaks on the call (optional, default en)

caller_id.description: Which number the other side sees (optional). 'own' shows the person's own verified number (start_own_caller_id) so they recognize who is calling; with none verified, no call is placed. 'business_line' shows the KaiCalls line. Left out, the account's saved choice applies. A free first call always shows the KaiCalls line

connect_me.description: True when the person wants to talk to `to` themselves, for example a business that answers on a cell phone: Kai rings the person's own phone saved on the account (set_owner_phone), says one line and connects them to `to`. Kai never speaks to `to`. Takes no lead_id and cannot be listen-only (optional)

connector_activation_call.description: True only for the one-time connector activation call the recipient explicitly requested in this conversation. This is not permission for marketing, SMS, or future calls.

external_ref.description: Your own reference for the conversation or task this call belongs to (up to 200 characters, optional). It comes back unchanged on check_call_status and on every webhook event for this call (call.question_pending, call.completed), so your agent can return the result to the right conversation.

hold_for_me.description: True when the person wants Kai to wait on hold for them: Kai calls `to`, gets through the phone menu and hold queue, and the moment a live person answers, says one line and connects the person's own phone saved on the account (set_owner_phone) so they do the talking. If they don't pick up, Kai does the task in context itself. Needs a saved phone and a plan (not on the free first call). Takes no lead_id and cannot be listen-only or connect_me (optional)

idempotency_key.description: Client-chosen key that makes this call exactly-once: retries with the same key never place a second call (optional but recommended)

listen_only.description: True to only listen: Kai calls a business, stays silent, records what answers (voicemail, answering service, phone menu or no answer) and hangs up within about 75 seconds without leaving a message. Takes no lead_id; context is ignored (optional)

report_language.description: Language the person asking reads, as a code or name (e.g. ar, ht, tr, bn, es, zh, vi). Kai confirms names, dates and numbers so the result can be relayed in this language (optional)

to.description: Phone number to call (E.164 format, e.g. +19085551234)

name: make_call
title: Make Call
